options.title: Count tracked notes files in the repository
options.how: A one-line shell command in the repository root counts files git tracks under notes/*.txt and prints notes_files as a level.
options.cost: One git ls-files per minute; reads only the index.
options.caveat: Counts committed files only, so a note written but not yet committed does not count until it lands on the branch the checkout is on.
options.clearance: cleared: reads only this machine, the project's own metrics store and its repository

provenance.author: owner
provenance.message: I want a feedback loop where once per day an agent runs and tries to improve how many notes files get added per day. I think we need to start tracking notes files. Create a Notes Files stock.
provenance.reason: The owner wants to track how many notes files the project holds, as the level the daily improvement loop tries to raise.

notes_improver.title: Notes Improver
notes_improver.description: Once a day, look at how many notes files the project gained and propose one concrete way to add more of them per day, so the Notes Files stock rises.

invariants: It never changes code or files itself; it only proposes work.
Every proposal names the Notes Files stock it aims to raise and says how it would be checked.
It reads the Notes Files stock and the ticket queue only.
It reads rejection and gate reasons only; it never changes tickets, code or files.
steps: 1. Once a day, read the Notes Files stock (notes_files) and the notes files added in the last day.
2. Read the day's DONE and REJECTED tickets and the merge gate's failures, with their rejection reasons (read only).
3. Group the reasons; for each recurring cause, write one idea that would stop it or add notes files, naming the stock it aims to raise and how it would be checked.
4. Publish the ideas as work.proposed events for the Coordinator to schedule; publish nothing if there are none.
uses: the ticket queue: DONE and REJECTED tickets, with their reviewer and gate rejection reasons (read only)
the merge gate's results for those tickets (read only)
